_mulierem te esse virtutis_ – that thou art a virtuous woman (Douay Version); dass du eine tugendhafte Frau bis (Arndt; similarly Luther); tu es une femme de vertu (Glaire). But considering the fact that _virtus_ rarely, if ever, has this meaning in the Vulgate, one should perhaps translate differently – “that you are a capable woman”; see on Ruth 4:11. – Kaulen, p. 34.
